sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, hl1.code AS highlight1Code, hl1.label AS highlight1Name, hl1.descr AS highlight1Description, hl2.code AS highlight2Code, hl2.label AS highlight2Name, hl2.descr AS highlight2Description FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale loc ON loc.IsDefault = @defaultLocale CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 h1d.HighlightCode AS code, COALESCE(h1l.AttributeDefaultValue, h1t.Name) AS label, h1t.Description AS descr FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue h1v INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute h1a ON h1a.PimAttributeId = h1v.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue h1pd ON h1pd.PimAttributeValueId = h1v.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue h1dv ON h1dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = h1pd.PimAttributeDefaultValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeHighlight h1d ON h1d.HighlightCode = h1dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale h1l ON h1l.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = h1dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AND h1l.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeHighlightLocale h1t ON h1t.HighlightId = h1d.HighlightId AND h1t.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId WHERE h1v.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND h1a.AttributeCode = @highlightsCode AND h1d.HighlightCode = @highlight1Code AND h1d.IsActive = @isActive ORDER BY h1d.HighlightId, h1pd.PimProductAttributeDefaultValueId) hl1 CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 h2d.HighlightCode AS code, COALESCE(h2l.AttributeDefaultValue, h2t.Name) AS label, h2t.Description AS descr FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue h2v INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute h2a ON h2a.PimAttributeId = h2v.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue h2pd ON h2pd.PimAttributeValueId = h2v.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValue h2dv ON h2dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = h2pd.PimAttributeDefaultValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeHighlight h2d ON h2d.HighlightCode = h2dv.AttributeDefaultValueCode LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale h2l ON h2l.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = h2dv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AND h2l.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeHighlightLocale h2t ON h2t.HighlightId = h2d.HighlightId AND h2t.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId WHERE h2v.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND h2a.AttributeCode = @highlightsCode AND h2d.HighlightCode = @highlight2Code AND h2d.IsActive = @isActive ORDER BY h2d.HighlightId, h2pd.PimProductAttributeDefaultValueId) hl2 WHERE p.ProductType = CONCAT(@productType, @productTypeSuffix) AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) ORDER BY p.SKU
